verdict.rationale: A fast edit-run loop is a fair question for a 3D/game library, but the evidence pack never documents hot reload, live preview, or iteration speed for three.js. The editor, devtools extension and import-map setup are mentioned only by name, with nothing tying them to fast script-change previews, so they earn no credit. Any hot reload would come from external bundler tooling, which is a user-side or host capability rather than the product's own.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change
